# SortableJS 1.15.7

- Upstream: https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable/tree/1.15.7
- Distribution: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SortableJS/Sortable/1.15.7/Sortable.min.js
- License: MIT (see LICENSE)

The unmodified browser distribution includes AutoScroll. It is loaded only by
shop admin product forms, before youngcart-admin.js. No runtime CDN or build is
required. When upgrading, replace the versioned file and update the template URL.
